main_measure.name: pooled slope of 10-bar excess forward return on forecast (forecast > 0, grid bars)
main_measure.threshold: slope t >= 2 confirms (with mean excess > 0); slope t <= -2 rejects

supporting_check.name: mean excess 10-bar return on the same cases above 0

decided_by: Neither rule met: the slope's t is between -2 and 2, or it is 2 or more while the supporting check fails.
reading: Grid bars on the same UTC day are summed (both excess return and forecast) into one case before the OLS regression; the coin's mean 10-bar return is the mean over all its windows' grid returns; the mean excess is over grid bars, and its t uses day-summed deviations.
